svg.title: ClaimClarity · Data backend
svg.desc: The whole ClaimClarity data backend: SFTP intake, the customer prefixes in the data bucket, the parser that writes them, sign-in, and the read path through the Claim Query Agent and the DuckDB query service, with the six AWS gates.
svg.text: FARGATE TASK · LIVES FOR ONE BATCH
CHAT API + RUN WORKERS · ECS ON FARGATE
